baslik: The Ranger Who Held His Crew Inside a Mine

sahneler.metin: In the American Northwest, many wildfires merged into one massive blaze.
Within two days it burned whole towns, killing eighty seven people.
Most of the dead were firefighters.
Ranger Ed Pulaski led his crew into a mine tunnel.
He held them there as the fire passed.
More than three million acres burned.
It raised public awareness of forest conservation.
It shaped fire suppression policy for decades.
